title: Geneformer Single-Cell Foundation Transformer Discovers Experimentally Validated Cardiomyopathy Targets
aiSystem: Geneformer (Single-Cell Transformer Pretrained on 30M Cells — Broad / Harvard)
whyItMatters: Pioneered single-cell foundation transformers on 30 million human transcriptomes; in silico gene perturbations discovered novel cardiomyopathy therapeutic targets that experimentally improved human iPSC heart-muscle contraction.
summary: Published in Nature in May 2023 by Christina V. Theodoris, Ling Xiao, Anant Chopra, Patrick T. Ellinor, and colleagues at the Broad Institute, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, and Harvard Medical School, Geneformer pretrained a context-aware attention transformer via masked rank-value modeling on Genecorpus-30M—a corpus of ~30 million human single-cell transcriptomes across diverse tissues. Fine-tuned with limited disease data, Geneformer predicted chromatin dynamics, dosage-sensitive disease genes, and gene-network hierarchy; critically, in silico deletion perturbations predicted candidate therapeutic targets for dilated cardiomyopathy whose experimental knockdown significantly improved contractile force in human iPSC-derived cardiac microtissues.
technicalHighlights: Encoded each cell as a rank-value ordered gene sequence and pretrained a self-supervised transformer on ~30 million single-cell human transcriptomes.
Achieved strong data-efficient transfer across chromatin-state, bivalent-promoter, transcription-factor hierarchy, and dosage-sensitivity prediction tasks.
In silico perturbation discovered novel cardiomyopathy therapeutic targets validated experimentally in human iPSC-derived cardiomyocyte disease models.
caveats: Subsequent systematic benchmarks noted that zero-shot single-cell foundation models do not always beat simpler baselines on all cell-type annotation or perturbation tasks, underscoring the value of task-specific fine-tuning and wet-lab validation.
institutions: Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard

scoreRationale.foundational: Established self-supervised single-cell foundation models capable of zero-/few-shot in silico genetic perturbation for network biology.
scoreRationale.ripple: Sparked the entire single-cell foundation-model and AI Virtual Cell movement (including C2S-Scale, scGPT, and State).
scoreRationale.verification: Peer-reviewed in Nature with wet-lab experimental validation in human iPSC-derived engineered cardiac microtissues.
scoreRationale.velocity: Enabled rapid virtual CRISPR-like screening across disease gene networks from sparse patient single-cell datasets.
